notes: Commit e245c6f fixes most of what held the last score back, and I checked each fix in the code. Seed venues in the keeper now run every proposal through venueTermsProblems (share against the venue's own venueOfferHeuristic ask, price band, capacity, minimum threshold, same-night double booking) and sign rejectShow with a reason the transcript can read ('X said no: venue share 1% below the 35% we ask'). Simulated fans only buy for shows that pass the same check, and their spending is capped per band and per run. The keeper refuses the mainnet genesis hash. Registration is wrapped in try/catch and only funds venue wallets that cannot already pay rent. Failed ticks back off from 5 s up to 120 s. keeper.yml uses `shell: bash` (so -eo pipefail) and counts 429s instead of only hiding them. The CLI reuses keyfile.ts and range-checks its numbers. VenueAgent.validate now requires integers, the dynamic imports are gone, and formatSol unifies transcript amounts. book.ts now carries planned days through DEMO_DAY_SEC. All 22 tests pass (~17 s) and typecheck is clean. Several problems remain. (1) The anti-drain caps live only in memory, reset every 10-minute run and are keyed per band profile, so an attacker with many cheap band wallets can still take about 0.3 SOL per run from the demo wallet (about 65% of it comes back to them as band share) until the wallet hits its floor. (2) venueTermsProblems computes the ask with draw = venue.capacity, not the band's real draw. It ignores the heuristic's own offer/fit verdict, offeredCapacity and minPriceLamports, and it does not check the deadline/sales window. So the keeper's venue is laxer than VenueAgent.onShowProposed and can disagree with the browser's ask. (3) The double-booking window of 150 s spans 75 demo days at DEMO_DAY_SEC = 2. band-agent.ts hard-codes the same 2 instead of sharing the constant. (4) Every tick still runs an unfiltered getProgramAccounts over every show ever created. (5) FanSim is not seeded from existing tickets, so each run's first tick retries purchases fans already made, and the 'already in use' error is retried once before it is dropped. keeper.test.ts now covers rejections and the term rules. It still does not cover the spend cap, the low-balance pause or a failing tick.
issues: packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:96-108,221: the fan budget is an in-memory Map that resets every run and is keyed by band profile, so many throwaway bands each get 0.05 SOL and together drain 0.3 SOL per 10-minute run (about 43 SOL/day ceiling) until the 0.02 SOL floor stops all fans, honest bands included. One tick can also overshoot a cap by up to maxBuysPerTick x 2 x price. Persist a daily total (for example a memo or a small state account, or read the payer's balance at run start and cap the run's delta), give a per-band budget only to bands with a completed show or an established profile, and check the cap per intent rather than per tick

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:50: the ask uses draw = venue.capacity and drops the heuristic's offer verdict, offeredCapacity and minPriceLamports. A band whose browser ask included the strong-history discount can be rejected, and off-programme or badly fitting bands are accepted whenever the share is high enough. Infer the draw from the proposal (capacity / SAMPLE, as book.ts does) and reject when !decision.offer or when capacity exceeds round(offeredCapacity * SAMPLE) bounded to 12-40

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:44-58: no sanity check on the proposal's timing. A threshold deadline seconds after acceptance (instant cancel) or days away (locks the venue's night and the fans) still passes. Require thresholdDeadline - now within, say, 10-90 minutes and date - deadline within the demo's show gap

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:32 with packages/web/src/lib/config.ts:12: sameDateSec = 150 is 75 tour days at DEMO_DAY_SEC = 2. Two bands that book the same venue within 2.5 minutes collide even when their planned days are weeks apart. Express the double-booking window in demo days (e.g. < DEMO_DAY_SEC) and share the constant

packages/agents/src/band-agent.ts:164: `p.day * 2` hard-codes the demo day while config.ts:8-11 claims the agents and the browser share DEMO_DAY_SEC. Move the constant into a pure module both import (e.g. agents/src/planner.ts or sol.ts)

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:167: `program.account.show.all()` is still an unfiltered getProgramAccounts over every show ever created, every 15 s. Settled and expired proposals are refetched forever. Filter by state with a memcmp on the state byte (one call each for proposed, onSale and confirmed), or keep a cursor of finished shows

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:225-226 with packages/agents/src/fan-sim.ts:96-101: a fresh FanSim with a fixed seed per run retries the fans who already bought. 'already in use' is not in the no-retry list, so each duplicate costs two failed sends plus 400 ms on the rate-limited RPC. Seed `bought` from the show's ticket accounts (ticketPda(show, fanKey) or listTicketsByShow) and add 'already in use' to the immediate-rethrow regex

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:209: the fairness re-check for fans passes [] for other dates, so two same-night shows that someone else signed with the public venue key both get demo-wallet fans. Pass the venue's liveDates minus the show itself

packages/agents/src/keeper.test.ts:40-117: no test for the spend caps (per band and per run), the low-balance pause, a tick that throws (backoff, failedTicks), registration failing without ending the run, or the mainnet guard (bypassed whenever deps are injected). Add a FakeChain case per guard, since the caps are the keeper's only anti-drain control

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:90: the guard is a deny-list of the mainnet genesis only, so any other cluster (testnet, a custom RPC) passes. Allow-list the devnet genesis (EtWTRABZaYq6iMfeYKouRu166VU2xqa1wcaWoxPkrZBG) and localhost URLs instead

.github/workflows/keeper.yml:48-49: `grep -v "429 Too Many"` also hides the keeper's own 'tick failed (...): 429 Too Many Requests' lines. A run in which every tick failed still exits 0, because keeper-cli only prints failedTicks. Filter only web3.js's 'Server responded with 429' retry lines, and have keeper-cli.ts exit non-zero when failedTicks is most of the ticks

.github/workflows/keeper.yml:14-16,25: the dispatch input `minutes` accepts up to 60 (keeper-cli.ts:27) but timeout-minutes is 12, so a long manual run is killed mid-tick. Cap the input to 9 or derive the timeout from it

packages/agents/src/keeper.ts:222,231 and packages/agents/src/orchestrator.ts:474: these log and note lines still use toFixed(4) instead of formatSol. The 'fan budget reached' line is logged every tick for each capped band, so log it once per band per run

README.md:48: the devnet section explains the keeper's term checks and spend cap but not that the seed venues' and fans' keys derive from the public world seed, so anyone can sign as them or sweep refunded fan wallets. Only docs/05-architecture.md and keeper.ts say so. Add one sentence
